# User — Access
{: .no_toc }

Turn apps on or off for one person; see every path that grants access.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACX-01` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/:userId/access` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/:userId/access` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (read), entitlements.manage or app owner (write) |
| **Kind** | tab |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwViewStack` page |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rows (one per app) | list | resolved status per app + paths (personal Entitlement, org grants) | StatusBadge + AccessSwitch on the personal path | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Paths disclosure | expandable | Entitlement.granted_via, source, subscription_id, organization_id, member_decision, starts_at/ends_at, disabled_reason | platform-managed paths (`free`, `subscription`) show a "Managed by Substratal" caption; developer grants and platform rows can coexist | AdwExpanderRow |
| Org-only access | caption + link |  | switch replaced by "Via {org}" → ORG-06 | GtkLabel .caption .dim-label |
| Grant access | primary-button | → ACX-02 |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Why? | button | → ACX-04 |  | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Switch off | `→ ACX-03 confirm → PATCH /entitlements/{id} {status:disabled, disabled_reason}` | Optimistic with Undo (PATCH status:active) for 10 s |
| Switch on | `PATCH /entitlements/{id} {status:active}` | No confirm |
| Remove grant made in error | `DELETE /entitlements/{id}` | Only developer grants with no order_id and < 24 h old; never on `free`/`subscription` rows (409 entitlement_platform_managed); 409 otherwise |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- The switch on a platform-managed row only disables / re-enables it (the platform never re-enables a row an admin disabled). Term, source and scope edits are hidden for those rows.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/{id}/entitlements?include_inactive=true` · `GET /applications`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
